title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: when an account qualifies for Private Client Money Market on an upgrade request
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when the owner of a Savings & Money Market Accounts account asks to move the account up to the highest-ranked money market tier they qualify for. It states when Private Client Money Market qualifies as the target.

## Policy clause

Private Client Money Market qualifies only when both of these hold:

1. the customer holds at least one active checking account of Private Client Money Market's required checking tier, Private Client Checking; and
2. the balance compared is at least Private Client Money Market's minimum opening deposit, USD 25000.00.

## Basis of decision

- **Authority.** The checking account's tier and status are read from the bank's checking records for the same customer. A customer's statement that they are a private client does not replace an active Private Client Checking account on record.
- **Object correlation.** The checking account must belong to the same customer who owns the savings account being upgraded; one active Private Client Checking account is enough, whatever other checking accounts the customer holds.

## Truth table

| At least one active Private Client Checking account held | Balance compared at least USD 25000.00 | Private Client Money Market |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | qualifies |
| yes | no | does not qualify |
| no | yes | does not qualify |
| no | no | does not qualify |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical balances)

| Checking held | Balance compared | Qualifies? |
|---|---|---|
| active Private Client Checking | USD 25000.00 | yes; equal to the minimum is enough |
| active Private Client Checking | USD 24999.99 | no; one cent short |
| active Premier Checking only | USD 80000.00 | no; the checking tier is not Private Client Checking |
| Private Client Checking, closed | USD 80000.00 | no; the checking account is not active |

## Points of judgement

**Does a large balance alone open Private Client Money Market?** No; both conditions must hold.

**Does holding Private Client Checking alone open it?** No; the balance compared must also reach USD 25000.00.
